name: cover-image
title: cover-image
description: A picture filling its frame edge to edge (cover fit), clipped by the frame. Owns its full style; resize or round via the Ref's style. Skeletons while its src loads.

definition.name: cover-image
definition.description: A picture filling its frame edge to edge (cover fit), clipped by the frame. Owns its full style; resize or round via the Ref's style. Skeletons while its src loads.
definition.whenToUse: Any image that fills a fixed-height band or tile — a page banner, a card's picture, a mosaic cell. Compose via a Ref, mapping src/alt to host fields; set height (and radius) on the Ref's style.
